Package com.github.query4j.optimizer

Class QueryOptimizerImpl

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.QueryOptimizerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueryOptimizer
public final class QueryOptimizerImpl extends Object implements QueryOptimizer
Thread-safe implementation of QueryOptimizer that coordinates multiple optimization strategies to provide comprehensive query analysis and suggestions.
